name: Valeo
old_description: At Valeo, we strive to create a workplace based on ethics, transparency, empowerment, professionalism and teamwork. Our employees and their well-being are at the heart of our operations and we believe in creating respectful and inclusive workplaces founded on these values.
about:
Valeo's U.S. operations trace back to 1980, when Valeo Auto Industries Inc. was established in Seymour, Indiana, to develop and sell thermal systems to major American automakers. The French multinational expanded through joint ventures with Eaton, Osram Sylvania, and V. Johnson Enterprises, and later acquired Blackstone and ITT Industries, solidifying its North American footprint. A joint venture with Raytheon evolved into Valeo Radar Systems, a wholly owned subsidiary. In 2017, the company added an engineering and innovation center in San Mateo, California.

Today, Valeo USA operates nine production sites, three development centers, and one service center across the country, with its regional headquarters in Troy, Michigan. Its North American plants manufacture a broad range of automotive systems: electrical systems, transmissions, engine management, air management, hybrid and electric vehicle systems, climate control, powertrain thermal systems, compressors, front-end modules, driving assistance, interior controls, interior electronics, lighting, wipers, and wiper motors. The organization is structured around three divisions—Brain, Power, and Light—focused on software-defined vehicles, electrification, and visibility technologies, respectively.

The company serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and the aftermarket through its Valeo Service division. It has earned recognition such as GM Supplier of the Year awards and participates in major industry events including the North American International Auto Show, CES, and South by Southwest.

Valeo states its mission is to make mobility cleaner, safer, and smarter, emphasizing ethics, transparency, empowerment, professionalism, and teamwork in its workplace culture.
